items.title: File Hinds County business personal property return
items.description: Mississippi owners of taxable personal property file a rendition with the county tax assessor; the assessor sets the filing date, which cannot be later than April 1. Failing to list property can raise the assessment by 10% (Miss. Code 27-35-45). Business property is assessed at 15%. The Hinds County assessor's own date was not confirmed; April 1 is the latest allowed. The link is the state rendition form.
